title: Mysterious Hairless Creature Spotted in California Neighbourhood
excerpt: A hairless creature spotted wandering a California neighbourhood leaves residents baffled and sparks questions about what it could really be
content:
A mysterious creature has appeared in a California neighborhood, leaving residents baffled. A passerby managed to capture the strange creature on video as it moved along a residential driveway. Its appearance was unlike any other animal common in the area.

The encounter happened in Mission Hills, San Diego, on November 21. Dan Fulkerson was walking through the area when he noticed something unusual. The creature had almost no visible fur, pale wrinkled skin and an oddly shaped body. He quickly took out his phone and recorded the unexpected sight.

The animal moved across the driveway before disappearing beneath a hedge. Its strange appearance immediately caught the attention of people watching the footage. Fulkerson later shared the video on Instagram, where it attracted millions of views.

The footage, originally shared on Instagram by Dan Fulkerson (@bulldoglawyer), sparked a flood of guesses and theories. Some viewers thought the creature resembled a hairless dog. Others suggested it might be a raccoon or a coyote with an unusual appearance.

https://ua-stena.info/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/california.mp4

However, its nearly bare skin made identification difficult. Even people familiar with local wildlife struggled to agree on what they were looking at.

The animal’s appearance raised another question. Was it naturally hairless, or had something changed its appearance? Its wrinkled skin and unusual proportions only added to the mystery.

The video soon spread across social media. Thousands of people shared their reactions and offered possible explanations. Yet the brief recording provided few clues about the creature’s identity or condition.

For now, the unusual visitor remains a fascinating subject of discussion. One short encounter was enough to turn an ordinary California driveway into the setting of a strange wildlife mystery.

Earlier, reports surfaced that Chilean fishermen had captured a mysterious creature on video. This revived an ancient legend about a terrifying creature said to inhabit local waters.
